The photo is not an overhead meal shot. It shows a single Royal Gala apple on a table, with a plate holding part of a toast slice with jam at the edge of the frame. The plate is barely visible, so it cannot work as a ruler. I sized the apple from its look instead. It appears fairly large, roughly 8 cm across, which suggests about 200 g. The toast is cropped and mostly out of frame, so I only counted the small visible portion at about 25 g, with a little jam on it.
